caption: The drawing depicts a wooden desk with a slanted front and four legs, rendered in shades of brown. The front of the desk features a drop-front panel decorated with wavy carved edges and a central keyhole with decorative gold-colored metal plating. Below this panel, there are four drawers in total: the top row has three smaller drawers—one in the center, and two on each side—each equipped with a round, gold-colored knob or pull. Underneath, there are three larger horizontal drawers, each adorned with two ornate, gold-colored handles and a central keyhole with gold-colored escutcheons. The sides of the desk are plain, and the base features bracket feet with a slight inward curve. The image is signed in black ink in the lower right corner with the text: "S. SAMUEL FINEMAN DEL-2394-1." The background is plain and off-white.
title: Desk
